# A09-S61: Correspondence

Correspondence extract. [████] marks redaction; […] marks omission.

[…]

Attached is a draft of what we could put in an application. I
 have tried to formulate it as relevant as possible for a municipal cultural council as
 possible :-) It is not a finished application, but I think there is enough for
 you to answer any questions with a clear conscience.

[████] has uploaded the first items. I don't know if there is a way to promote it more within your network? I have deliberately only hinted at JULINA's upcoming existence at this stage. Thinking it should have a tremendous fanfare when it is ready for use.




Besides, I thought maybe we should post something on your old 
 website, mindfuture.ai?
